incidents.finding: On January 12, 2026, yoUSD's own automated harvester executed an unfavorable stkGHO-to-USDC swap against assets of the Ethereum yoUSD vault 0x0000000f2eb9f69274678c76222b35eec7588a65. The source transaction sent 3,840,651.397502403762632376 stkGHO from the vault and ultimately returned approximately 112,036 USDC; YO subsequently confirmed a USD 3.7 million reserve shortfall. Independent analysis attributes the execution to an unreasonable starting quote and ineffective slippage guardrails, not a malicious exploit. The Pendle yoUSD market was temporarily paused. A same-day replenishment transferred 3,711,640.477024321032215381 stkGHO back to the vault. YO's January 14 disclosure states that treasury funds fully covered the shortfall, user balances were unaffected and protocol solvency was not impaired. The roughly 97% loss was on the swapped position, not on total vault NAV or the yoUSD market price. This row records the realized reserve-management failure and associated operational interruption, not a mint compromise, share-accounting/oracle exploit, documented whole-token depeg, or currently active loss.

incidents.finding: On March 22, 2026, the Resolv incident impaired yoUSD through its RLP strategy exposure. YO initially reported 2.75% RLP exposure and paused the vault; the same day it reopened deposits and withdrawals with a 2.95% withdrawal fee aligned with then-current RLP exposure. The fee accrued to remaining holders and was an actual loss for users who exited. YO's April proposal, subsequently revised, states a 1,214,131.87 USDC RLP impairment, models share NAV falling from approximately 1.0722 to 1.0447 (2.56%), proposes removing the withdrawal fee and carving recovery rights out to affected holders, and records a holder snapshot at April 16 15:46 UTC. Those figures describe different dates and mechanics, not interchangeable loss rates. YO explicitly declined treasury coverage for this external strategy loss, unlike the January operational loss. June announcements describe a USDC distribution plus RESOLV tokens vesting over 24 months, not unconditional full cash recovery. This is sourced holder-exit/NAV impairment, not a yoUSD mint exploit or evidence that its USD market price fell below one dollar.
